text: また　わしの　ポケモン　じまんを　ききに　きたの　かね！

structure.jp: わしの　ポケモン　じまんを　ききに　きたの　かね！
structure.en: you came to hear my Pokémon bragging, did you!

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb with its ます cut off plus に, before a verb of coming or going, says what you come or go to do. ききに　きた = 'came to listen'.

patterns.name: 〜のかね
patterns.explanation: の asks for an explanation and かね is a soft question ending used by older men to someone younger. きたの　かね = 'so you came, did you?'.
